source.rationale: P2, the carried-vs-renamed test. _ceKey collapses an entity to `canonical_code || raw`, so a RESOLVED entity in prior state keys on its code while the LLM, re-typing it, keys on its name. The two sets never intersect, so the entity reads as untouched-carry even though the customer just named it - fork exec 13246777 -> spine exec 13246769, where retyping the customer lost it and the answer covered 20 orders across other companies. Here the customer re-types the product by name ('YOO WIDE PANEL 2400', prior canonical SRTWC286) on a reuse turn, so the final set holds the PRIOR (resolved) form while the raw snapshot holds the NAME. Before the fix both prior entities read as carried, nothing contributes, _rcEvict stays false and the certificate bound to the OLD lookup survives as a live narrowing filter. After it, the re-named product counts as a product-scope contribution, so the stale carried certificate is evicted (carried_attachment_evicted) - the entity the customer named is treated as named.
